name: The Boss
tagline: The Protector, the Leader, or the Challenger

items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Instinctive (body/gut).

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Outward: energy to impact, transform, or dominate the environment.

items.label: Central issue
items.value: Managing anger and the need for autonomy in the face of a reality perceived as resistant or unjust.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoid weakness, vulnerability, and dependence at all costs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Lust: a need for excess, intensity, and constant stimulation.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Vengeance / punitive resentment: a will to settle scores with a world perceived as harsh.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Denial (of vulnerability/pain) and negation (rejection of limits/authority).

items.label: Egotic pride
items.value: I am strong, I am just.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being harmed, controlled, dominated, or violated by others.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Protecting oneself and determining one's own path.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Survival / satisfaction: mastery of material resources and personal territory.

children.label: Social
children.value: Friendship / complicity: protector of the clan, alliances with the loyal and the strong.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Possession / surrender: fusional intensity while keeping control.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Assertive (moving against): insists on its needs, moves against to get what it wants.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Reactive: immediate responses, frankness, open expression of frustration.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 7 (energetic, adventurous) and wing 9 (calm, protective, grounded).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 2: a more open heart, generosity, attentiveness, owned tenderness.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 5: withdrawal, secrecy, coldness, cynicism, strategizing in the shadows.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Truth: the perception of the fundamental unity of reality (nothing is separate).

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Innocence: undefended openness, a fresh response to the moment.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: True strength (Red): vitality and the capacity to act without fear, grounded in Being.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Guilt / badness: feeling bad or excluded from grace.

children.label: Specific reaction
children.value: Blaming: casting fault onto others to avoid feeling one's own defect.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Duality: the world experienced as a battlefield between the strong and the weak.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner little 2: tender and affectionate, learned to hide its needs in order to survive.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Imperatives: direct, blunt, authoritative, gets to the point.

items.label: Communication misunderstanding
items.value: Force-Brutality: frankness/power perceived as gratuitous aggression.

sections.title: Evolution and relationships
sections.desc: Warning signs, growth practices, confusions, interactions.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Growing belligerence, enemies everywhere, the posture of an arrogant dictator.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Waiting before acting, recognizing physical limits, accepting that true strength includes vulnerability.

items.label: Common confusions
items.value: Counterphobic 6, 1 (justice), 3 (competition), sexual 4 (intensity).

children.label: In love
children.value: Protective and passionate; can be smothering/jealous if it fears betrayal.

children.label: At work
children.value: Natural leader, effective decision-maker; hates indecision/hypocrisy; delegation is difficult due to a need for control.

levels.text: Magnanimous heart: noble protection, power in service of the true.
Self-confident person: calm strength, presence, courage.
Constructive leader: protective leadership, justice, useful action.
Enterprising adventurer: intensity, taste for challenge, increased control.
Dominating power broker: imposes, tests, hardens relationships.
Omnipotent megalomaniac: paranoia of control, omnipotence.
Violent destroyer: rampage, total rupture, devastation.

items.label: Consciousness
items.value: Moving from the ego's fight to Self-Surrender to a strength greater than one's own will.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: RED (power, force, immediate action).

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A volcano ready to erupt, or a lion that moves only when hungry: massive energy, decisive action.
